SELECT "p"."viewcount", "u"."displayname"
FROM "posts" "p"
INNER JOIN "users" "u" ON "p"."owneruserid" = "u"."id"
WHERE "p"."title" = 'Computer Game Datasets'
LIMIT 500

per_case_results.question: How many comments were added to the post with the highest score?
per_case_results.expected_sql: SELECT COUNT(T2.Id) FROM posts AS T1 INNER JOIN comments AS T2 ON T1.Id = T2.PostId GROUP BY T1.Id ORDER BY T1.Score DESC NULLS LAST LIMIT 1
per_case_results.actual_sql:
SELECT COUNT("comments"."id")
FROM "comments"
INNER JOIN "posts" ON "comments"."postid" = "posts"."id"
WHERE "posts"."score" = (SELECT MAX("score") FROM "posts")
LIMIT 500

per_case_results.question: Provide the text of the latest 10 comments to the post with the title 'Analysing wind data with R' and the display name of the user who left it.
per_case_results.expected_sql: SELECT T3.Text, T1.DisplayName FROM users AS T1 INNER JOIN posts AS T2 ON T1.Id = T2.OwnerUserId INNER JOIN comments AS T3 ON T2.Id = T3.PostId WHERE T2.Title = 'Analysing wind data with R' ORDER BY T1.CreationDate DESC NULLS LAST LIMIT 10
per_case_results.actual_sql:
SELECT "c"."text", "c"."userdisplayname"
FROM "comments" "c"
INNER JOIN "posts" "p" ON "c"."postid" = "p"."id"
WHERE "p"."title" = 'Analysing wind data with R'
ORDER BY "c"."creationdate" DESC
LIMIT 10

per_case_results.question: Among all the posts posted by the most influential user, identify the percentage with a score above 50.
per_case_results.expected_sql: SELECT CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN T2.Score > 50 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS REAL) * 100 / NULLIF(COUNT(T1.Id), 0) FROM users AS T1 INNER JOIN posts AS T2 ON T1.Id = T2.OwnerUserId INNER JOIN (SELECT MAX(Reputation) AS max_reputation FROM users) AS T3 ON T1.Reputation = T3.max_reputation
per_case_results.actual_sql:
SELECT 
    (COUNT(CASE WHEN "posts"."score" > 50 THEN 1 END) * 100.0) / COUNT(*) AS percentage
FROM "posts"
INNER JOIN "users" ON "posts"."owneruserid" = "users"."id"
WHERE "users"."reputation" = (SELECT MAX("reputation") FROM "users")
LIMIT 500

per_case_results.question: Give the user's reputation and up vote number of the user that commented "fine, you win :)".
per_case_results.expected_sql: SELECT T2.Reputation, T2.UpVotes FROM comments AS T1 INNER JOIN users AS T2 ON T1.UserId = T2.Id WHERE T1.Text = 'fine, you win :)'
per_case_results.actual_sql:
SELECT "u"."reputation", "u"."upvotes"
FROM "comments" "c"
INNER JOIN "users" "u" ON "c"."userid" = "u"."id"
WHERE "c"."text" = 'fine, you win :)'
LIMIT 500

per_case_results.question: Among the posts with views ranging from 100 to 150, what is the comment with the highest score?
per_case_results.expected_sql: SELECT Text FROM comments WHERE PostId IN (SELECT Id FROM posts WHERE ViewCount BETWEEN 100 AND 150) ORDER BY Score DESC NULLS LAST LIMIT 1
per_case_results.actual_sql:
SELECT "c"."text", "c"."score", "c"."id", "p"."viewcount"
FROM "comments" "c"
INNER JOIN "posts" "p" ON "c"."postid" = "p"."id"
WHERE "p"."viewcount" BETWEEN 100 AND 150
ORDER BY "c"."score" DESC
LIMIT 1

per_case_results.question: In posts with 1 comment, how many of the comments have 0 score?
per_case_results.expected_sql: SELECT COUNT(T1.id) FROM comments AS T1 INNER JOIN posts AS T2 ON T1.PostId = T2.Id WHERE T2.CommentCount = 1 AND T2.Score = 0
per_case_results.actual_sql:
SELECT COUNT(*) 
FROM "comments" "c"
INNER JOIN "posts" "p" ON "c"."postid" = "p"."id"
WHERE "p"."commentcount" = 1
AND "c"."score" = 0
LIMIT 500

per_case_results.question: Among the comments with scores between 5 to 10, what is the percentage of the users with 0 up votes?
per_case_results.expected_sql: SELECT CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN T1.UpVotes = 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS REAL) * 100 / NULLIF(COUNT(T1.Id), 0) AS per FROM users AS T1 INNER JOIN comments AS T2 ON T1.Id = T2.UserId WHERE T2.Score BETWEEN 5 AND 10
per_case_results.actual_sql:
SELECT 
    CAST(COUNT(CASE WHEN "users"."upvotes" = 0 THEN 1 END) AS DOUBLE PRECISION) * 100.0 / COUNT(*) 
FROM "comments" 
INNER JOIN "users" ON "comments"."userid" = "users"."id"
WHERE "comments"."score" BETWEEN 5 AND 10
LIMIT 500
